summary: The WelcomeStaffAdmin module provides a staff administrative interface within the HSPnet system for viewing, filtering, and managing student employment applications. The page contains workflow and validation logic to enable users to filter applications by site, discipline, and submitted date range, with the ability to include withdrawn applications. It uses a grid to display results and leverages ASP.NET server controls, validation logic, and AJAX for an interactive experience.
purpose: To allow staff administrators to efficiently search, review, and filter student employment applications based on agency, site, discipline, submission dates, and withdrawal status.

fields.name: ddSite
fields.description: Site where application is submitted; populated from Sites.GetByAgencyID.

fields.name: gvwApplications
fields.description: Displays the list of applications matching filters.

actors: Staff administrator (system user with access to staff admin functions)

workflows.name: Filter and View Student Employment Applications
steps: Staff admin accesses the WelcomeStaffAdmin page.
User is greeted with their name and last login time.
Dropdowns for site and discipline are populated (site: by current agency, discipline: all available).
Start and end dates are pre-populated (defaulting to past 3 months).
User may adjust filter values (site, discipline, date range, withdrawn applications checkbox).
Validators ensure that both date fields are populated, in correct format, and that End Date >= Start Date.
On 'Refresh View', the grid gvwApplications is rebound with results matching filters.
Results include applicant name, site, submission date, status, withdrawn date, etc.
If no results, a message is displayed.
User can open application details in a new window.
Email links, if present, enable composing an email to applicant.
Any errors and warnings during filtering are displayed in floating panels.

business_rules: Start and End date fields are required.
Start and End date fields must match date format.
End date must not be earlier than Start date.
Grid displays only applications matching all selected criteria.
Withdrawn applications are only included if checkbox is checked.
Dropdown for discipline includes an 'All' entry inserted at the top.
validations: RegularExpressionValidator on txtStartDate and txtEndDate to enforce date format.
CustomValidator on EndDate: End Date must not be before Start Date (checked by JS function checkStartEnd).
calculations: Date range defaults: StartDate = today minus 3 months, EndDate = today.
conditions: If SiteID is in querystring, that site is selected by default.
If Email field for an applicant is empty, the email icon is hidden.
If WithdrawnDate is present, applicant is marked as withdrawn.
system_behavior: Uses asynchronous postbacks for filtering (via UpdatePanel).
Auto-populates fields and remembers user session info (name, last login, timezone).
Displays errors and warnings in floating panels that can be hidden.
Dynamic injection of JavaScript variable bindings for start/end date fields.
dependencies: Sites.GetByAgencyID and Disciplines.DisciplineList for populating dropdowns.
AJAX Control Toolkit for calendar pickers and floating panels.
exceptions: If invalid date format is entered, user is prevented from submitting the filter.
If End Date precedes Start Date, validation error is shown.
If no records, grid displays 'No Data' message.
